Keep headings moderate (22/18/15px), body text solid without glow, controls accessible, mobile layouts responsive and motion optional. Avoid white backgrounds, rainbow colors, glow everywhere and turning ordinary answers into dashboards. Only add small content-specific CSS; do not duplicate the theme.
